closed_zones: Bidi/RTL Processing Split (Local vs. Remote) — absorbed into 'Normalize-before-detect null-detector lattice (presentation forms / NFKC)': its core claim (NFKC destroys the Arabic presentation-form signal, null-detector fallacy) is now the dominant mechanism of the merged zone rather than a standalone local-vs-remote deployment-drift story; the heading-guard-never-committed sub-issue is not mentioned in the post-fix zone and was not separately verified as fixed.
new_zones: Config-layer bifurcation: frozen snapshot vs live os.environ — newly surfaced; no prior zone described the frozen pipeline_config snapshot vs live os.environ re-reads (BIDI_COHERENCE_ENFORCE truthiness mismatch, LEAF_SPLIT_RATIO re-read at call time defeating the import-time coupling assertion, PRE_GARBLE_FORCE_OCR_ENABLED double-source).

zone_deltas.zone_name: Verdict-Gate Threshold/Promotion/Override Cascade -> ExtractionState route/ok multi-writer cascade
zone_deltas.key_change: The zone file for the original threshold/promotion cascade was deleted in 083aa6e as 'resolved', but the underlying order-dependent, multi-writer verdict problem resurfaced under a new name centered on ExtractionState.ok/route/gate_result instead of apply_promotions; bug count dropped 8->7 but severity is unchanged and the fix is still not authoritative (five separate recovery methods still assign state.route/state.ok without re-deriving from gate_result).

zone_deltas.zone_name: Garble Detection Cross-Cutting Kernel -> Normalize-before-detect null-detector lattice (presentation forms / NFKC)
zone_deltas.key_change: The garble-kernel zone absorbed the Bidi/RTL zone's NFKC/presentation-forms null-detector mechanism (previously a separate High-severity zone); had_presentation_forms now has exactly one live producer (_renormalize_bidi_guarded) versus a dead 'Arabic' string-comparison fallback in detect_garble, and recovery paths (_execute_ocr_retry, _recover_vlm_fallback) still actively null out the one carrier that exists. Net bug count nudged down (7->6) but the flag remains structurally unproducible on most paths.

zone_deltas.zone_name: OCR Recovery Cascade and Kill-Switch Conflation -> Recovery dispatch: tuple-keyed dedup and unguarded raising normalizers
zone_deltas.key_change: decide_ocr_mode now forwards document_type/ocr_langs (closing one prior bug), and the single _OCR_ESCALATION kill-switch conflation is narrower; remaining defects shifted to a tuple-keyed dedup set that still double-fires _recover_image_dominant_ocr for co-occurring NODE_COUNT_LOW/DEPTH_LOW gates, and ensure_tessdata's new TessdataUnavailableError is caught in one call site but raised bare in another (image-extension branch), producing inconsistent ERROR-vs-MARGINAL outcomes.

zone_deltas.zone_name: Converter Chain Fallback and AGPL Gating -> Ordered-policy converter chain with load-bearing branch order
zone_deltas.key_change: Commit 0625ecb ('gate the AGPL structural fallback and close remote converter drift') closed the unconditional structural-failure-walks-to-AGPL bug the pre-fix audit flagged, but a new bug of equal severity took its place: the RETRY branch's bare `continue` advances to the NEXT chain entry instead of re-entering the same one, so with the default retry count of 1 the very first transient failure of the primary converter can walk straight past BLOCK_AGPL into an AGPL converter anyway — same net HR4 exposure, different code path.

zone_deltas.zone_name: Dual-Writer Verdict Persistence and Consistency Model Split -> Split verdict authority: five writers over two stores
zone_deltas.key_change: The zone file was deleted in 083aa6e as resolved, but the writer count grew from two (save_doc_meta, _upsert_registry_row) to five (adding registry_backfill/reconcile.py, registry_backfill/backfill.py, and promotion_sweep.py), and the audit now identifies a false belief baked into backfill.py's own comment ('the CAS guard in save_doc_meta protects against clobbering a newer verdict') that is contradicted by save_doc_meta's actual implementation, which has no priority comparison at all. Severity raised High->Critical to reflect that corpus audits reading sidecars can now disagree with the registry through more independent paths than before.

zone_deltas.zone_name: Erasure Cascade and Storage Consistency Drift -> Order-coupled erasure manifest with implicit inter-step data flow
zone_deltas.key_change: No structural change: the manifest is still a hand-maintained ordered list with implicit inter-step data dependencies (doc_name recovered mid-cascade, sha256 read from a sidecar file a later required step deletes) and required=False steps that let a missed purge log at DEBUG as an 'expected miss' rather than surfacing as an error.

zone_deltas.zone_name: Measurement/Audit Tooling Shared Blind Spots -> Divergent parallel garble/text accessors
zone_deltas.key_change: The block.get('text','') blind spot for table/image blocks was partially closed (Zone-9 header-only-table fix landed inside _flat_block_primary_text per commit 98b5038), but the audit now documents that this is only one of several near-identical text accessors (_flat_search_text, the flat.py table branch, and detect_garble vs. the _garble_check_nodes whole-tree fallback which bypasses detect_garble's presentation-forms recovery heuristic entirely) — so the fix closed one instance while confirming the zone has no single choke point, raising severity from Medium to High even though bug count held at 4.
